Question: assalam o alikum my mother saw a dream that she is carryin a pot full of milk for makin tea but then she comes to know that theres some fly or insect in it,, after some time she saw small lizard in milk and she thinks not to use the milk .please give tabeer to my dream? jazaakallah Answer ID: 21121 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 758/580/H=1431) There is some fault in belief and practice. It is the meaning of the dream. And the dream strongly warns you to turn towards its remedy. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
